title: Talented lyrical genius DD released his recent track "Came A Long Way"
htmlContent:
DD, also known as DDSWAG, is a talented lyrical genius and poetic expert who has taken out time to learn all there is to learn from his craft. The talented star drops his highly anticipated "Came A Long Way" track and is currently breaking bars with his path.

In his recent song "Came A Long Way," DD captures the raw essence of his origins. “Came A Long Way” symbolizes past reflections of DD's life and how its shaped his overall reality and belief system bringing him where he is today. The music knocks for every second and makes you turn it up to the highest level while you take on the savagery of the music in an authentic way.
